claire (sales): Quick: Prospect Helix wants a 4-week isolated POC. Must be fully offline (no outbound), signed artifacts, small monthly security patches, quarterly feature rollouts, and HSM-based verification. They also want a clear rollback story and evidence for audits.
josh (sales-eng): Tech constraints? OS? registry?
claire (sales): They run CentOS Stream 9, internal registry only, strict egress policy.
emma (security): Must deliver SBOM + signed manifest. Prefer customer-provided KMS pubkey for verification. Ask if they require FIPS crypto.
dev (solutions): We can provide three delivery options: 1) Signed full bundle (tar.gz + manifest) for manual import, 2) Delta micro-bundles for security patches (small diffs), 3) Transient staging node that pulls diffs then seals to cluster. For windows <3h pre-stage blobs on nodes. Rollback uses previous manifest and atomic switch; we keep checksums and signed manifests.
josh (sales-eng): Pricing: propose one-time POC packaging fee (covers initial offline automation) + optional ongoing support add-on for automated delta generation. No license uplift.
emma (security): If Helix wants us to sign, legal + key-escrow required. Better: they give KMS pubkey; we sign artifacts locally so they verify. Also define audit log retention (suggest 1 year default).
courier-bot: package rb-20260415-airgap-demo prepared (id: rb-20260415-07) :package:
dev (solutions): I'll prepare a 10-min ops demo showing apply + rollback and an ops checklist (cert rotation, SBOM, KMS test).
claire (sales): Action items: 1) I ask Helix for transfer method and maintenance window. 2) Josh to draft SOW with one-time fee. 3) Emma to produce KMS/HSM checklist and FIPS question. 4) Dev to build demo runbook.
emma (security): I'll include required attestations and suggested manifest format.
josh (sales-eng): ETA runbook + SOW draft by Tue EOD.
